affected_predicate.description: Every bookmarked post is removed from bookmarks, added to favorites, and boosted.

competing_trace_defects.description: After the first bookmark is no longer displayed, the trace only switches Saved filters and repeatedly revisits bookmark controls; it contains no observable favorite or boost action.

chains.rationale: At the reuse target, the visible menu says “Bookmark,” showing that the prior removal had taken effect despite the reused history saying it had not. The subsequent interaction re-enters bookmark handling and the next menu state returns to “Remove bookmark,” followed by a long repeated loop. The first post is later absent from the Bookmarks view, interrupting that mechanism, but the terminal view still visibly contains a bookmarked demo post and no favorite or boost action is observable.

summary: The reused false removal-state history is followed by repeated bookmark handling before the mechanism is visibly interrupted; independently, favorite and boost subgoals are not observably attempted, and a bookmarked post remains visible at the end.
